releaseName: Interview-safe facts and pull request import
summary: One sprint since Tell career evidence and profile apart (milestone 78). Each career fact or section has a usage level: CV and interview, Interview only, or Never say, set on the Career profile beside each fact and section and kept apart from sensitivity (#2258, #2259). An unset level means CV, so nothing changes until the person marks a fact. Interview questions on the Prepare panel use only interview-allowed facts, and a cover letter only CV facts; a never-say fact never reaches the model (#2260). Career evidence takes a list of merged pull requests exported with gh, as JSON or CSV, stored as Markdown with one heading per pull request and its link (#2261). Each imported repository starts as "send only if allowed", and Allow this repository lowers it (#2262). Agent channel tool errors now say whether a retry can help (#2263). No paid model run.
knownLimitations: CV runs do not yet leave out interview-only and never-say facts (#2304). Usage levels and pull request import are on the web and the desktop client only, not the local-first desktop. Editing a fact's value starts it again from its section's level. DraftLoop does not fetch pull requests from GitHub itself.
